yawn.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: animation sprite sheet for an existing realistic desktop pet.
Input image 1: identity reference only, a normal adult brown mackerel tabby cat called Rousong. Preserve this cat's realistic fur, body proportions, yellow-green eyes, pale muzzle and chin, striped forehead and ringed tail. Ignore the red pixel fringe in the reference; output clean fur edges.
Primary request: one chronological 16-frame yawning animation sheet, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows in reading order. Genuinely transparent background. Each cell equal size, with generous transparent gutters. Same camera and subject scale and same seated body/feet position across all cells. Full cat visible in every cell, tail and ears never cropped. Photorealistic fur, not cartoon.
Motion sequence: 1 calm seated three-quarter front cat, mouth closed; 2 sleepy eyelids; 3 eyes almost closed and muzzle begins parting; 4 jaw opens a little; 5 jaw opens a quarter; 6 jaw opens halfway; 7 jaw opens three-quarters; 8 full natural yawn with closed eyes and visible curved pink tongue; 9 full yawn apex, head only slightly tilted upward; 10 jaw begins to close; 11 half closed; 12 quarter closed; 13 mouth closed; 14 small tongue tip briefly licks lips; 15 tongue retracted and relaxed eyes; 16 same calm seated pose as frame 1.
All 16 are consecutive small changes of ONE cat performing ONE yawn; do not reset the pose at the start of rows. Keep chest, paws, body size and lighting stable. Let neck naturally lengthen slightly during yawn, no neck distortion. Mouth anatomy must be a cat, small natural teeth, no monstrous jaw. No extra legs, no duplicated limbs, no two heads, no collars, props, text, labels, borders, watermark, ground plane or cast shadows. Request high resolution approximately 2048x2048.
